coverage.instructions: Compare only SOURCE UNIT facts against CURRENT complete mapped counterparts. Different wording and shared canonical defaults count. Only source facts in this unit matter: an unrelated source-disagreement note elsewhere does not make this unit curated. criteria.covered: All actionable source-unit facts are consistently represented with no source-disagreement override affecting this unit.
criteria.gap: At least one actionable source-unit fact is missing and no unacknowledged contradiction exists.
criteria.conflict: At least one actionable source-unit contract is contradicted without an explicit justified source-disagreement note.
criteria.curated: All actionable source-unit facts are represented and an explicit bounded source-disagreement explanation affects this unit.
